source.source_name: Companies Registry — List of Newly Incorporated / Registered / Re-domiciled Companies (Open Data)

pagination.next_page_path: data.gov.hk CKAN package_search enumerates weekly RNC063L_<YYYYMMDD>.csv and RNC063F_<YYYYMMDD>.csv URLs

parsing.notes: Two weekly CSV streams: RNC063L (newly incorporated LOCAL companies) and RNC063F (newly registered NON-HK companies); both include name-change rows. CSV is UTF-8 with BOM; quote all fields. Dates DD-MM-YYYY. Identifier is the BR Number (IRD), NOT the CR Company Number. No personal data. Incremental feed — accumulate weekly files. Enumerate weekly file dates via the data.gov.hk CKAN API (package_search id hk-cr-crdata-list-newly-registered-companies-2526).

mapping_rules.tax_id: BR Number (HK has no VAT; BR Number is the business id).
mapping_rules.legal_name: Current Company Name in English (RNC063L) / Current Corporate Name (RNC063F).
mapping_rules.incorporation_date: Date of Incorporation (RNC063L) / Date of Registration (RNC063F), DD-MM-YYYY -> ISO.
mapping_rules.status: Derive 'newly_incorporated' / 'newly_registered' / 'name_change' from the stream and populated dates.

fixture_requirements: name-change row (Date of Change of name populated, no incorporation date)

live_test_plan.smoke: Download RNC063L_20241230.csv; expect ~3,286 rows with header Seq,Current Company Name in English,Current Company Name in Chinese,BR Number,Date of Incorporation,Date of Change of name.
live_test_plan.full: Enumerate weekly RNC063L/RNC063F files via CKAN; ingest and accumulate keyed on BR Number.
